m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>You hear a low wailing. Is it the wind and the waves, or something more?
Who are you Outlander, that risks the dread curse of Grimhilde IronSpear? A Wizard? The last Wizard I knew cost me my life.
You wish to help me? I will not be at peace until that vile captain pays for his deeds. Until then, I will haunt him to his last days.
Prove your words! My namesake Iron Spear is in the bristles of the strident White Razors. Retrieve it for me!
My weapon! I thought I would never see her again. You have done well, Wizard. I will tell you this much...
Captain Coleridge's evils will not be forgiven until every member of his crew can finally rest. You take that message to him!
And some in dreams assured were, of the Spirit that plagued us so; Nine fathom deep she had followed us, from the land of mist and snow.
Quick, Spellbinder, what did you see?
You are not a spirit, so I cannot see why you would bother with me. She haunts me so...
I care not what you want, I cannot think. She plagues me every wakin' moment, and her wailin' keeps me from sleep.
It is beyond me power to aid you unless the Spirit of Crescent Beach is put to rest!
Spellbinder, you go search for this Spirit. I will stay here and watch the Rat. I hope he is not sending you on a wild hornet chase.
The Spirit of Crescent Beach must be put to rest! I cannot think nor sleep nor eat with her hauntin' me!
